notes.title: Update to the Combat Arena
notes.content:
📢 [b]A Message From Us:[/b] We added a direct message from our Game Designer.

🎮 [b]Navigation Controls:[/b] No more confusion! We've created a comprehensive guide detailing all the navigation controls within the game. Navigate like a pro!

🏟️ [b]Arena Asset Organization:[/b] Say goodbye to clutter! We've reorganized the assets within the arenas for a smoother and more immersive gameplay experience.

🌊 [b]Updated Enemy Waves:[/b] Get ready for more action! We've revamped the enemy waves, adding new challenges and adjusting quantities for an adrenaline-pumping experience.

🐛 [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] We've squashed those pesky bugs! From minor glitches to unexpected hiccups, our team has been hard at work ensuring a smoother gaming experience for all players.

🎨 [b]Visual Refresh:[/b] Immerse yourself in a refreshed world! We've updated the colors, tones, and in-game assets to enhance the overall visual appeal and make every moment in Fix Fixer even more captivating.

Dive back in now and experience these exciting updates firsthand! Your feedback drives our progress.
